name: Marks Electrical Group PLC
summary: Marks Electrical Group PLC functions as a leading online vendor of electrical goods throughout the United Kingdom. The company provides a full suite of services, including the sale, delivery, and expert installation of both household electrical appliances and a diverse range of consumer electronic devices. Established in 1987, the firm, headquartered in Leicester, UK, rebranded to Marks Electrical Group PLC in October 2021, having previously operated under the name Marks Electrical Holding Limited.
